info.name: ZWA Checkout Read-Only Phase 3.5H.1
info.description: Read-only local regtest API. No purchase or signing request. The receipt-not-yet-available case requires a fresh active quote.

exec: pm.test('regtest read-only metadata', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.network).to.eql('regtest'); pm.expect(body.demoOnly).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.signingAvailableOverHttp).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.trustSource).to.eql('EXPERIMENTAL_REGTEST'); pm.expect(body.availability.state).to.be.oneOf(['AVAILABLE','NODE_UNAVAILABLE','WRONG_NETWORK']); });

pm.test('recorded sponsored quote', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.source).to.eql('RECORDED_REGTEST_EVIDENCE'); pm.expect(body.actionable).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.quote.quantity).to.eql(7); pm.expect(body.quote.paymentAmount).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(body.quote.maximumTotalDebit).to.eql(10000); pm.expect(body.quote.networkFee).to.eql(5000); pm.expect(body.quote.feePayer).to.eql('DISPOSABLE_REGTEST_SPONSOR'); pm.expect(body.quote.matcherFee).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('human run is recorded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.sessionId).to.eql('recorded-phase35h'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('RECORDED_REGTEST_EVIDENCE'); pm.expect(body.actionable).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.receipt.sessionId).to.eql(body.sessionId); pm.expect(body.receipt.txid).to.eql('aaeb15b837d5b44fc6aaf6d88b36ac9b802cd53e6cd2cf292ef8450db6826dfd'); pm.expect(body.receipt.finality).to.eql('UNKNOWN'); });

pm.test('matching historical receipt', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.sessionId).to.eql('recorded-phase35h'); pm.expect(body.txid).to.eql('aaeb15b837d5b44fc6aaf6d88b36ac9b802cd53e6cd2cf292ef8450db6826dfd'); pm.expect(body.height).to.eql(103); pm.expect(body.blockHash).to.eql('7ece7eadb0fda860e9d2f49add753174da9a04d4e64a4a1c3ced90e15f0cd13a'); pm.expect(body.purchaseSettlement).to.eql('ACCEPTED'); pm.expect(body.rootedLineage).to.eql('UNSUPPORTED'); pm.expect(body.investorEligibility).to.eql('NOT_EVALUATED'); pm.expect(body.finality).to.eql('UNKNOWN'); });

request.description: Run only after the original disposable node is stopped; a fresh chain with the same RPC port is not evidence for this transaction.

exec: pm.test('old live session fails closed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); pm.expect(body.sessionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('human_session_id')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('NODE_UNAVAILABLE'); });
pm.test('malformed ID is absent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('NOT_FOUND'); });

request.description: Set quote_ready_session_id to a genuine active QUOTE_READY session and run before any submission. Skip this request otherwise.

exec: pm.test('valid quote has no receipt yet', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(body.error.code).to.eql('RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE'); });

request.description: With nothing listening on unavailable_base_url, Postman reports a connection error and does not execute test scripts. Verify the UI treats it as UNAVAILABLE. This request does not execute payments.
